notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and Dawnsire.
Resolve the Dawnsire trigger, attempting to deal 100 damage to Crystalline Crawler, which will result in 100 +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
